title: [Crash] System.Runtime.InteropServices.InvalidComObjectException: COM object that has been separated from its underlying RCW cannot be used.
author: zgabi
body_snippet:
## Crash Report

### Exception
**Type:** `System.Runtime.InteropServices.InvalidComObjectException`
**Message:** COM object that has been separated from its underlying RCW cannot be used.

### Stack Trace

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks for the report @zgabi. This is a known WinForms framework-level issue — the RDP ActiveX control (`AxHost`) receives a Windows message after its COM object is already released during tab close/disconnect. It's **non-fatal** (the app continues running), and we already have `InvalidComObjectException` guards in the Dispose paths of `InterfaceControl` and `ConnectionTab`.
